- Quote: "we need chat that feels instant, and blocks toxicity fast — players leave after one bad convo".
- Preference: prefer hosted API to move fast, cost-sensitive (tight burn), want predictable per-message cost.
- Current stack: Node backend + in-house websocket layer, using Stream for presence but want smarter moderation + LLM-driven personalization.
- POC idea: use hosted_api for moderation classification + short reply generation for suggested quick responses; fallback simple templates when model unavailable.
- Model preferences: small open models for cost, will consider Redwood-verified variants; interested in quantized options.
- Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to a rule-based filter if model latency spikes.
- Data concerns: minimal PII, but need audit logs for moderation decisions for player support; retention policy TBD.
- Pricing sensitivity: want to trial w/ 30-90 day usage window; potential commit if results show 40% reduction in reported abuse incidents and <200ms p50 latency for suggestion generation.
